reviews.comment: You have to be prepared and do your homework before you go to the classroom, but once you're prepared, you can learn a lot from her class. She is always willing to answer questions and replies really fast. A must take class.

You cant expect to go into class and learn directly from her, read one example from the book and understand it then go into class. Doing this makes the class a joke. She's very smart but can't always convey what she wants so already knowing something about the subject makes everything click really easily. The mid was easy TA gave us the questions

reviews.comment: Worst Professor Ever. Unclear, unhelpful, and useless. This class has a 100% guarantee of making you consider dropping out. Other side effects of taking this class include, but are not limited to; extreme stress, drowsiness, PAIN, frustration, job applications to Kohls, and (last but not least) failing grades. Do ANYTHING to not take this prof.
